title: Federation relationship
description: An explicit relationship between two parties: who, which scope, for what purpose, until when, revocable how, under which policy version. A party is a node and the scope it holds; a personal scope or vault is never a party and never the scope a relationship covers. One party proposes and the other accepts; a record without both acceptances is not established. Validated by validateRelationship in src/engine/federation/membership.mjs; docs/FEDERATION.md describes it.

type.description: The scope types of the identity model other than personal.

parties.description: The proposer first. The two nodes differ.

accepted_at.description: When the party accepted, or null while it has not.

revoked_by.description: The node that revoked; one of the two parties.

policy_version.description: The version of the policy document both parties accepted.
